determination.verdict: A source-backed rank-3 qNM-to-Bresciani map does NOT exist. The Bresciani operator basis is rank 3 but carries no QNM map; the only public ringdown analysis is rank 1 per parity-even theory (max parity-even sourceable rank 2 across the two separately-bounded quartic theories); and the parity-odd third axis g_R4_c3 = Im(K_minus) is explicitly deferred, hence dark. The negative result is preserved; no projection is manufactured.

correct_claim: Public sources cap the qNM-to-Bresciani sensitivity at the parity-even quartic subspace (rank 1 per theory in the published analysis). The parity-odd engine axis g_R4_c3 is unconstrained by current ringdown observables, so a full-rank R4 ringdown discriminator is not source-backed.
incorrect_claim: The repo can invert ringdown data into all three Bresciani R4 axes, or constrains the CP-violating quartic operator from current ringdown.
